css: .button { backdrop-filter: blur(8px); border-radius: 8px; color: rgb(244, 240, 255); display: block; padding: 8px 16px; position: relative; width: max-content; }
.button::before, .button::after, .button-border { border-radius: inherit; height: 100%; left: 0px; position: absolute; top: 0px; width: 100%; z-index: -1; }
.button::before, .button::after { content: ""; display: block; transition: opacity 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.6, 0.6, 0, 1); }

.button-primary .button-border::before { background: linear-gradient(rgba(207, 184, 255, 0.24), rgba(207, 184, 255, 0)), linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(207, 184, 255, 0.32), rgba(207, 184, 255, 0.32)); border-radius: inherit; content: ""; inset: 0px; mask: linear-gradient(rgb(255, 255, 255) 0px, rgb(255, 255, 255) 0px) content-box exclude, linear-gradient(rgb(255, 255, 255) 0px, rgb(255, 255, 255) 0px
.button-primary::before { background: linear-gradient(rgba(60, 8, 126, 0), rgba(60, 8, 126, 0.32)), rgba(113, 47, 255, 0.12); box-shadow: rgba(191, 151, 255, 0.24) 0px 0px 12px inset; }
.button-primary::after { background: linear-gradient(rgba(60, 8, 126, 0), rgba(60, 8, 126, 0.42)), rgba(113, 47, 255, 0.24); box-shadow: rgba(191, 151, 255, 0.44) 0px 0px 12px inset; }
.button-secondary::before { background: linear-gradient(rgba(243, 238, 255, 0), rgba(243, 238, 255, 0.04)), rgba(147, 130, 255, 0.01); box-shadow: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) 0px 0px 12px inset; }
.button-secondary::after { box-shadow: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) 0px 0px 12px inset; background: linear-gradient(rgba(243, 238, 255, 0), rgba(243, 238, 255, 0.05)), rgba(147, 130, 255, 0.04); }
.button { backdrop-filter: blur(8px); border-radius: 8px; color: rgb(244, 240, 255); display: block; padding: 8px 16px; position: relative; width: max-content; }
.button::before, .button::after, .button-border { border-radius: inherit; height: 100%; left: 0px; position: absolute; top: 0px; width: 100%; z-index: -1; }
.button::before, .button::after { content: ""; display: block; transition: opacity 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.6, 0.6, 0, 1); }
